taskVersion.name: ves-real-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1874 | 2.78 | 2.78
2 | 2428 | 9.13 | 11.9
3 | 1071 | 15.2 | 27.1
4 | 3706 | 32.2 | 59.3
5 | 178 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: KHK-type (five-layer curve: resistivity rises 1874→2428 Ω·m, falls to 1071 Ω·m, rises sharply to 3706 Ω·m, then drops to 178 Ω·m)
Aquifer depth: >59.3 m (top of the low-resistivity, 178 Ω·m layer; base not resolved by this sounding)
Recommendation: Drill through the resistive overburden (0–59.3 m) with casing/grouting to seal off the intermediate 1071 Ω·m zone, and target the saturated, low-resistivity (178 Ω·m) layer below 59.3 m as the main production aquifer; verify total depth with drill cuttings/geophysical logging since the base of this unit is not constrained by the VES data.
